evals.prompt: 我写了一篇讲 Agent Loop 的公众号技术文章，帮我画一张 SVG 闭环流程图，展示 Goal -> Plan -> Act -> Observe -> Feedback Loop 的完整过程。
evals.expected_output: 一张默认 16:9（1200x675，或按复杂度选用 wechat_article 宽 1200、高 500–1200）的 bg_dark 闭环流程图及对应 layout.json：默认采用 25px 微圆点阵（background_style='dot'）配区外 label-halos 同底遮罩，遵循 Scheme 3 莫兰迪色板与 Color-by-Source 连线原则，所有通用英文词翻译为中文，元素在 Safe Area 内，连线正交且无遮挡、无遗留临时预览目录。
assertions: The output SVG uses the wechat_article canvas width 1200 (default 16:9 viewBox 0 0 1200 675, height in 500–1200) with a non-transparent #050506 background, 25px dot-grid (or solid fallback if dense), label-halos before edges, and 1px clipped outer border
All visible text elements have font-size >= 16px and declare an unquoted font-family stack without system-ui from assets/fonts-whitelist.json (passes validate_svg.py --strict with zero tofu boxes)
Generic English terms (Agent, Loop, Goal, Plan, Act, Observe, Feedback Loop) are translated into Chinese per language policy
All colors follow Scheme 3 tokens and achieve contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 against their resolved background (validate_svg.py --strict and validate_color.py --strict pass)

A matching agent-loop.layout.json contract file (with metadata.background_style='dot' or 'solid' if dense) is produced and passes validate_geometry.py --strict with zero overlaps or out-of-safe-area elements

evals.prompt: 帮我做一张双核对比的 SVG 图卡用于公众号正文，左边是传统 RAG 检索（Query -> 向量检索 -> 拼接 Prompt -> LLM 生成），右边是 Agentic RAG 检索（Query -> 智能体路由与改写 -> 多工具/知识库迭代检索 -> 反思校验 -> LLM 生成）。
evals.expected_output: 一张默认 16:9（1200x675，或紧凑 2.4:1 1200x500）的双栏/双核对比 SVG 图卡及对应 layout.json：comparison 类型路由到纯色无网格底板（background_style='solid'），采用 Scheme 3 莫兰迪强调色，中文优先并保留白名单缩写（RAG, LLM），非白名单英文翻译或用 data-svga-text-kind 标注，字号 >= 16px，通过几何、色彩与语言校验。
assertions: The output SVG uses the wechat_article canvas width 1200 (16:9 1200x675 default or compact 1200x500) with solid flat background (metadata.background_style='solid', no grid pattern) and 1px clipped outer border
All visible text elements have font-size >= 16px, unquoted non-system-ui font stacks, and render cleanly in cairosvg without tofu boxes
All visible text passes validate_language.py --strict (allowlisted RAG/LLM kept; non-allowlisted terms translated or wrapped with data-svga-text-kind)
All colors come from Scheme 3 theme tokens (Color-by-Source / semantic contrast) and achieve >= 4.5:1 text contrast (validate_color.py and validate_svg.py pass)
A matching rag-vs-agentic.layout.json contract file is produced and passes validate_geometry.py --strict

evals.prompt: 把现有的 gateway-arch.svg 改一下：主标题改成“AI 网关高可用架构 (Claude & OpenAI 双引擎)”，另外把图里右侧的“Order Service”节点改成“计费与限流中心”，并在底部加一条从“计费与限流中心”回到“API 网关”的异步审计虚线。请直接在原文件上更新，不要残留草稿或预览图。
evals.expected_output: 原位更新 gateway-arch.svg 及其 layout.json（无多余新建 SVG 或残留 preview 目录），主标题居中混排英文（Claude & OpenAI）不触发 cairosvg 多 tspan 居中重叠（拆分为独立 text 或安全锚点），Order Service 替换为中文“计费与限流中心”，新增底部正交返回虚线且端口分离不穿过其他节点。
assertions: gateway-arch.svg is updated in-place with zero leftover draft SVGs or preview directories in the output folder
The right node title 'Order Service' is replaced with '计费与限流中心' and a dashed orthogonal edge with label '异步审计' connects it back to 'API 网关'
The centered mixed-language main title avoids combining text-anchor='middle' with multiple <tspan> children (passes E_TEXT_TSPAN_ANCHOR_UNSAFE and renders without horizontal gap/overlap in cairosvg)
All text elements including the new '异步审计' edge label maintain font-size >= 16px and unquoted approved fonts
gateway-arch.layout.json is synchronized with the new edge/text boxes and passes validate_geometry.py --strict

evals.prompt: 帮我用浅色纸白风格画一张大语言模型演进时间轴（2022–2026），包含 4 个核心里程碑节点，突出工程蓝图刻度感，输出适合公众号正文的 16:9 SVG。
evals.expected_output: 一张 bg_light（#F7F5F0 纸白底 + #FFFFFF 主卡 + #CCC7BD 1px 外框）16:9 演进时间轴 SVG 及对应 layout.json，timeline 类型自动匹配 background_style='line'（40x40px 1px 淡暖灰线网 #D6D2C9 @ 0.48）配预置 label-halos 同底遮罩，遵循 Scheme 3 莫兰迪色板、5 级字体阶梯及中文优先规范。
assertions: Uses bg_light (#F7F5F0 paper background, #FFFFFF cards, 1px #CCC7BD outer border) on default 16:9 1200x675 canvas
Routes timeline diagram to metadata.background_style='line' with a 40x40px 1px faint grid pattern (#D6D2C9) and pre-edge label-halos cutout group
All text >= 16px with >= 4.5:1 contrast using Scheme 3 bg_light tokens (validate_svg.py --strict, validate_color.py --strict, validate_geometry.py --strict all pass)
